decisions.statement: The credential is the whole Cookie header from a signed-in session rather than an issued key.
The CSRF token is cut from the cookie rather than held apart from that cookie.
A cookie with no csrftoken is refused.
The headers handed out cannot be altered by their holder.
The refusal says the cookie expires and says who can produce another.
Only Alan at a signed-in browser can produce a cookie.
Nothing here keeps a cookie or reads a cookie from a file.

definition: the Monarch session headers, built from the cookie a signed-in browser holds
